rca_inverse_correlation: Brief assumed foreign net buy would support a bullish market, but a net sell of Rp 252,65 Miliar occurred, yet IHSG still closed bullish (+1.21%).
Brief's context mentioned Rupiah strengthening contributing to a bullish market, but today Rupiah weakened (+0.951%), yet IHSG still closed bullish (+1.21%).
lessons: Ketika Foreign Flow diprediksi Stagnant/Sideways (Net Buy Rp829.70 Miliar), tetapi Foreign Flow aktual adalah Distribution (Net Sell Rp 252,65 Miliar) terjadi, maka IHSG tetap menguat +1.21%.

Ketika beberapa sektor diprediksi Bearish (Kesehatan, Konsumsi Primer, Energi Oil & Gas Upstream) atau Neutral (Properti), tetapi semua sektor saham naik dengan Transportation memimpin +3.33%, Technology +2.59%, dan Energy +2.33% terjadi, maka IHSG menguat +1.21%.
summary: The morning brief correctly predicted a bullish IHSG, but underestimated foreign selling pressure and the broad-based sector rally, while also missing key global and domestic risks.
